text:
Mara: quick design drop 1 — single-line version rows, tiny variant pills, and a compact rollback flow. figma: https://figma.redwood/compact-v2
Owen: nice. two quick Qs: 1) verb choice: Restore / Revert / Switch? 2) where does undo live?
Lina: prefer 'Restore' in modal, 'Switch' as the short inline label. keeps language friendly but distinct.
Vik: backend uses action 'rollback' and audit logs rely on it. propose we show friendly copy in UI and include 'action: rollback' in the details section.
Mara: agreed. UI copy: inline button 'Switch' opens confirm modal titled 'Restore deployment'. details show raw action.
Owen: canary pill idea: 'canary  10%' (percent visible) with a visually-hidden label 'Canary allocation 10 percent' for screen readers.
Lina: add aria-describedby from pill to a tooltip that explains allocation and keyboard shortcut. tooltip must have role='tooltip'.
Vik: implementation: slider + numeric input in flyout; changes only persist on Save. watch for concurrent autoscaling races.
Mara: confirmation modal copy draft: header 'Restore deployment', body 'Switch traffic and config to v123. In-flight requests may be affected. This does NOT delete versions.', primary 'Restore now', secondary 'Cancel', helper 'technical action: rollback'.
Owen: safety: 20s cancellable countdown with progress bar and 'Force now' option. if forced: call rollback?force=true.
Lina: accessibility rules: trap focus in modal, return focus to row after close, announce success/failure via aria-live='polite'. motion reduced respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Vik: diff preview: one-line human summary (e.g., 'LOG_LEVEL: INFO  DEBUG; workers: 8  12') with expand to monospace JSON. badges for added/removed must include text labels.
Mara: microcopy nits: inline 'Switch' for compact rows, modal 'Restore', tech details show 'rollback'. Simon will decide final term in review.
qa-bot: QA: automated tests added for keyboard navigation, tooltip a11y, and undo snackbar behaviour.
Mara: action items: Owen to refine pill spacing and keyboard tooltip, Lina to write aria strings and live region messages, Vik to confirm API payload shape and force param. will iterate in tomorrow's review. :sparkles:
